description: List messages over an inclusive YYYY-MM-DD window, paginated, in the same shape as list_invoices plus page counters. The window may span at most 60 days and is read as UTC. filtru narrows by type: E errors, T sent, P received, R awaiting a response.

cif.description: Defaults to the CIF in app.json. With or without the RO prefix; both are accepted.

test.description: Query ANAF's test environment instead of production.

name: list_invoices_window
title: List e-Factura messages over a date window
